name: ztpf_change_history_on_device
why: "What have we changed on this box?" -- the audit question. It is not the
same as summarizing one run group: the answer spans EIGHT run groups and
23 steps, so it forces the grouping the analyst FIXMEs asked for (by run
group, steps in stepNumber order) and it is the scenario most likely to
be answered from a truncated first page and presented as complete.
Deliberately phrased the way an engineer phrases it, not in module terms.

steps.user: Hey -- on this device, what have we done to make changes? Make me a list.
